original.target_description: Primary report located; assigned Study 9/outcome/sample/test not uniquely identified. Candidates span temporary sharing, disinhibition, and perceived-judgment tests.

notes:
Identity: canonical text identifies Europe PMC fullTextXML provenance (PMC5692543), matches the reference title exactly, gives issue date 2017 Nov 7, and embeds the matching DOI 10.1073/pnas.1706913114 in its supplemental-information link. Contribution initials R.H., R.R., L.K.J. are compatible with the named authors; a full author byline is not reproduced. The source contains primary empirical Results and Discussion, Materials and Methods, and supporting study details, rather than an abstract-only excerpt or preregistration. Identity supported internally; no network verification.

The assigned study identifier is 9, but the supplied primary text labels main studies 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6A, 6B, 7A and 7B, without an explicit mapping to Study 9. The description summarizes the paper and does not identify one outcome/sample/test. The OSF file is not the supplied source, and canonical text has no page markers to establish the p. 2 locator. Multiple tests fit the description. Counting studies to reinterpret 9 as 7B would be an unsupported ordinal assignment.

No PDF was supplied; no rendering attempted. Null original statistics reflect unresolved target correspondence, not source unavailability. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. No metric conversions or N derivations performed.
